description.en: The number of days to retain backups.

description.zh:
备份周期。
指定每周备份日期，多个日期需用英文逗号`,`隔开。
description.en: The backup cycle. Specify the days of the week for backups. Separate multiple days with commas (`,`).

description.zh:
执行备份的`UTC`时间范围。
例如`12:00Z-13:00Z`，则表示将在`UTC`时间的`12:00`到`13:00`之间开始执行备份。
description.en: The UTC time range to perform the backup. For example, `12:00Z-13:00Z` means that the backup starts between 12:00 and 13:00 UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun clickhouse create-backup-policy --db-instance-id cc-2ze0eb0w182xh8549 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --preferred-backup-time 10:00Z-11:00Z --preferred-backup-period Monday,Friday --backup-retention-period 8 --api-version 2023-05-22 --region cn-hangzhou
